name: Brussels Sprouts

low.description: About 5 medium sprouts or 3/4 cup chopped

siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO diets. The fiber content may cause gas in sensitive individuals, so introduce gradually.
preparationTips: Remove outer leaves and trim the stem end before cooking
Cut larger sprouts in half for even cooking
Roasting at high heat (400°F) caramelizes edges and reduces bitterness
Steam for 6-8 minutes or roast for 20-25 minutes until tender
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of vitamin K for bone health
High in vitamin C for immune support
Good source of folate and fiber
